t: 2031 — First component hulls product ships at scale: CVD diamonds synth
title: 2031 — First component hulls product ships at scale: CVD diamonds synth
definition: 2031 milestone on the Lab Diamond Components 2.0 roadmap.
description:
First component hulls product ships at scale: CVD diamonds synthesis proven outside the lab.

What must be true first: the CVD diamonds results have to replicate outside the lab, component logistics manufacturing must reach pilot scale, and doping control operations need a year of continuous runtime. Miss any one and the date slips — that is the honest mechanics of forecasting. The Signature timeline pulls this earlier by integrating the pieces from day one.

Signals to watch: peer-reviewed CVD diamonds demonstrations, component logistics cost curves bending down, and operators — not vendors — reporting doping control uptime. When all three flash green, 2031 stops being a forecast and starts being a schedule. (5 years from the 2026 baseline.)

title: Readiness Estimator: Lab Diamond Components 2.0
definition: Estimates Lab Diamond Components 2.0 readiness from component maturity.
description:
The estimator scores the six Lab Diamond Components 2.0 components on the TRL 1–9 scale and averages them into a verdict: research phase, pilot phase, or deployment phase. Scores derive from the component records in this database — change a component's maturity and the verdict moves.

Honest scoring is the point: a component hulls that averages TRL 3 is not failing, it is three phases from deployment, and the estimator tells you which component drags the average down. Fund that one first.

title: Lab Diamond Components 2.0 Systems Simulator
definition: Simulates Lab Diamond Components 2.0 operating for a day.
description:
The simulator walks a Lab Diamond Components 2.0 installation through six operating steps, with seeded randomness standing in for real-world variation. Seed 27624 reproduces this exact run — change the seed in the program to explore other days.

Watch for DEGRADED steps: they mark where CVD diamonds monitoring, component logistics redundancy, or doping control maintenance would intervene in a real deployment. A simulator that never degrades is lying; this one degrades about eight percent of the time, like early hardware does.

title: Lab Diamond Components 2.0 Master Roadmap
definition: The united roadmap for Lab Diamond Components 2.0: prove, build, operate, compound.
description:
The master roadmap for Lab Diamond Components 2.0 — next-gen lab-grown diamond parts.

Phase 1 — Prove (CVD diamonds): laboratory demonstrations of every component, replicated independently. No scaling until the physics is boring.

Phase 2 — Build (component logistics): pilot manufacturing and integration. The six pieces meet for the first time and the interfaces get honest.

Phase 3 — Operate (doping control): continuous real-world operation. Uptime, cost curves and failure data replace projections.

Phase 4 — Compound (thermal spreaders): component hulls as everyday infrastructure. Costs collapse, standards settle, and electronics-scale deployment begins.

Signature edition: phases overlap aggressively — integration starts on day one. This record unites the database: overview, research, components, milestones, demos and drills all point here.

Each phase has exit criteria.
